headline: Gesture Recognizer の結果を action gate で安定化する
headlineEn: Stabilizing Gesture Recognizer results with an action gate
summary: Google AI Edge の Gesture Recognizer Web guide、GestureRecognizer JS API、公式 samples を確認し、カメラ入力の `recognizeForVideo()` と synthetic stream の両方で、enter / exit threshold、hold frames、cooldown による action gate を試せる自作 HTML サンプルを追加しました。
summaryEn: After reviewing the Google AI Edge Gesture Recognizer web guide, GestureRecognizer JS API, and official samples, today's original HTML sample tests an action gate with enter/exit thresholds, hold frames, and cooldown using both live camera `recognizeForVideo()` and a synthetic stream.
keyTopics: Gesture Recognizer は手の gesture category、handedness、image landmarks、world landmarks を返し、ジェスチャーからアプリ機能を呼び出す用途に向いている。
Web 版は `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` の `GestureRecognizer` を使い、静止画では `recognize()`、動画では `recognizeForVideo(videoFrame, timestamp)` を使う。
公式 API は `setOptions()` で一部 option を更新でき、score threshold、label allowlist / denylist、running mode などを設計要素として扱える。
動画フレームでの recognition は同期的に UI thread をブロックし得るため、action 側では hold / cooldown / frame skipping を前提にしたほうが安全。
生の gesture winner を action に直結すると誤発火しやすいので、enter threshold と exit threshold を分ける hysteresis が小さな UI でも効く。
keyTopicsEn: Gesture Recognizer returns gesture categories, handedness, image landmarks, and world landmarks, making it suitable for invoking application features from hand gestures.
On the web, `GestureRecognizer` from `@mediapipe/tasks-vision` uses `recognize()` for still images and `recognizeForVideo(videoFrame, timestamp)` for video.
The official API supports partial option updates through `setOptions()`, making score threshold, label allowlist / denylist, and running mode part of the design surface.
Recognition on video frames can synchronously block the UI thread, so hold, cooldown, and frame skipping should be considered in the action layer.
Mapping the raw gesture winner directly to actions causes false triggers; hysteresis with separate enter and exit thresholds helps even in small UI prototypes.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable example and why it matters
sections.body: 今日の注目は Gesture Recognizer が landmarks と gesture category を同時に返す点です。Hand Landmarker は 21 点の形を扱う土台でしたが、Gesture Recognizer は Thumb_Up や Victory のような意味ラベルを返すため、UI command やモード切り替えへ接続しやすくなります。ただし、スコアが一瞬上がっただけで action を発火すると誤操作になるので、認識結果からアクションまでの gate が重要です。
sections.bodyEn: Today's notable point is that Gesture Recognizer returns both landmarks and gesture categories. Hand Landmarker gives the 21-point foundation, while Gesture Recognizer adds semantic labels such as Thumb_Up or Victory, making it easier to connect to UI commands or mode switches. However, firing an action when a score spikes for one frame causes false operations, so the gate between recognition result and action is important.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: サンプルは Open_Palm、Closed_Fist、Pointing_Up、Thumb_Up、Victory、ILoveYou の synthetic score stream を生成し、棒グラフで生スコアと平滑化後の状態を見せます。さらに `Start Camera` で GestureRecognizer model と webcam を起動し、`recognizeForVideo()` の実スコアを同じ action gate に流し込めます。Enter threshold、Exit threshold、Hold frames、Cooldown frames を調整すると、同じ認識スコアでも action が発火したり保留されたりします。
sections.bodyEn: The sample generates a synthetic score stream for Open_Palm, Closed_Fist, Pointing_Up, Thumb_Up, Victory, and ILoveYou, then visualizes raw and smoothed scores as bars. `Start Camera` also loads the GestureRecognizer model and webcam, feeding real `recognizeForVideo()` scores into the same action gate. Adjusting enter threshold, exit threshold, hold frames, and cooldown frames changes whether the same recognition score fires or waits.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: Gesture Recognizer の出力は `gestures`、`handedness`、`landmarks`、`worldLandmarks` の配列として扱います。UI action へ使う時は winner category だけでなく score、handedness、前回状態、hold 時間を一緒に見るのが実用的です。`recognizeForVideo()` は同期処理なので、毎フレーム必ず呼ぶより、video timestamp の更新確認、低頻度推論、UI 側の補間、Web Worker 化を組み合わせる設計にした方が安定します。
sections.bodyEn: Gesture Recognizer output should be treated as arrays of `gestures`, `handedness`, `landmarks`, and `worldLandmarks`. For UI actions, use not only the winning category but also score, handedness, previous state, and hold duration. Because `recognizeForVideo()` is synchronous, a stable design should combine video timestamp checks, lower-frequency inference, UI interpolation, and possibly Web Worker execution rather than calling it unconditionally every frame.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 次は Image Segmenter と Interactive Segmenter を見て、ランドマーク型の入力とマスク型の入力を比較します。Gesture 側では label allowlist / denylist、custom gesture recognizer、handedness ごとの action map、両手入力の衝突解決を継続して追います。特に両手ジェスチャーは action gate を片手単位から session 単位へ拡張する必要があります。
sections.bodyEn: Next, watch Image Segmenter and Interactive Segmenter to compare landmark-based and mask-based inputs. For gestures, continue tracking label allowlist / denylist, custom gesture recognizers, handedness-specific action maps, and conflict resolution for two-hand input. Two-hand gestures especially require extending the action gate from per-hand logic to session-level arbitration.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: まず Noisy User に切り替えて Noise を上げ、gate の動きを合成ストリームで確認してください。次に `Start Camera` を押してカメラ許可を与え、実手の gesture score が raw winner に入ることを見ます。Enter threshold を低くすると誤発火が増え、Hold frames と Cooldown を上げると発火は遅くなる代わりに安定します。
sections.bodyEn: First switch to Noisy User and raise Noise to inspect the gate with a synthetic stream. Then press `Start Camera`, grant camera permission, and confirm real hand gesture scores enter the raw winner. Lowering the enter threshold increases false triggers, while increasing hold frames and cooldown makes firing slower but more stable.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: 調査: Gesture Recognizer Web guide、Gesture recognition overview、GestureRecognizer JS API、公式 samples web、google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples-web を確認。アイデア: Hand Landmarker の次として、認識カテゴリを action へ変換する gate を作る。実装: synthetic gesture score stream、webcam `recognizeForVideo()`、score smoothing、enter / exit threshold、hold frames、cooldown、accepted action log、live preview を 1 ファイル HTML にまとめる。検証: JSON parse、HTML script 構文、gallery 再生成、publish を行う。
sections.bodyEn: Research: reviewed the Gesture Recognizer web guide, gesture recognition overview, GestureRecognizer JS API, official samples web, and google-ai-edge/mediapipe-samples-web. Idea: follow Hand Landmarker by building the gate that converts recognition categories into actions. Implementation: package a synthetic gesture score stream, webcam `recognizeForVideo()`, score smoothing, enter/exit thresholds, hold frames, cooldown, accepted-action log, and live preview into one HTML file. Validation: parse JSON, check HTML script syntax, regenerate the gallery, and publish.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: MediaPipe daily の流れは、7/31 の Hand Landmarker で landmark 表示、8/1 の Gesture Recognizer で action 化へ進めました。ここで重要なのは、ML の出力をそのまま UI に接続せず、confidence、時間、前回状態を挟むことです。この層があると、今後の Pose、Face、Segmenter でも同じ考え方で誤発火やちらつきを抑えられます。
sections.bodyEn: The MediaPipe daily sequence moves from landmark display with Hand Landmarker on July 31 to action mapping with Gesture Recognizer on August 1. The important pattern is to avoid wiring ML output directly into UI; confidence, time, and previous state should sit in between. This layer will also help reduce false triggers and flicker in future Pose, Face, and Segmenter samples.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 採用した候補は `Gesture Action Hysteresis Gate` です。実際に動く部分は synthetic gesture score stream、実カメラ `recognizeForVideo()`、平滑化、enter / exit threshold、hold frames、cooldown、accepted action log です。次に足すなら、handedness ごとの action map、両手 gesture の conflict resolver、custom gesture recognizer の model 差し替え UI を追加します。
sections.bodyEn: The selected prototype is `Gesture Action Hysteresis Gate`. The working parts are the synthetic gesture score stream, live camera `recognizeForVideo()`, smoothing, enter/exit thresholds, hold frames, cooldown, and accepted-action log. Next additions should include handedness-specific action maps, two-hand gesture conflict resolution, and a model-switching UI for custom gesture recognizers.
